about: I work on Applied AI at EPAM. I build AI systems that survive contact with real users, and I care about the boring parts: clear documentation, visible behaviour, nothing surprising in production. Away from work I run a homelab, write about games in my newsletter Il giocatore, and ship small tools nobody asked for.

targets.blurb: A small game about shifts, made for Game Off 2026
